headline: Public hearings on zoning changes, including an Upzoning Overlay District at Davis, Porter, and Ball Squares.
summary: Five mayor's requests would change zoning rules on building parts, sustainable development, and other topics. A separate ordinance from Councilor Scott would create the Upzoning Overlay District.
items: Ordinance 26-1579 by Councilor Scott: establish the Upzoning Overlay District at Davis Square, Porter Square, and Ball Square (public hearing)
Mayor's request 26-1528: simplify rules for building components (public hearing)
Mayor's request 26-1527: allow more sustainable development elements (public hearing)
Mayor's request 26-1526: simplify rules for accessory structures (public hearing)
Mayor's request 26-1525: amend use tables and standards (public hearing)
Mayor's request 26-1261: streamline the jurisdiction of review boards (public hearing)
